statement.p: Write the rational number 0.772772772\ldots as a fraction.

solution.p: The three-digit number 772 repeats after the decimal. So we will make use of the three-digit denominator 999\text{.} And we have \frac{772}{999}\text{.}

statement.p: Write the rational number 0.69696969\ldots as a fraction.

solution.p: The two-digit number 69 repeats after the decimal. So we will make use of the two-digit denominator 99\text{.} And we have \frac{69}{99}\text{.} But this fraction can be reduced to \frac{23}{33}\text{.}
